goal: Train a real MIT-BIH single-lead 5-class heartbeat model on the user's complete downloaded dataset, evaluate independent subjects, export ONNX + exact PulseLab manifest and deploy default. No synthetic training samples and no fabricated performance. Main owns all execution and integration.
inventory: training/dataset_inventory.json (already verified 144 required files; 48 records;47 subjects; 201/202 same group)

descriptions.N: 非异位类（含正常、束支阻滞及部分逸搏）
descriptions.Q: 起搏、起搏融合及不可分类；主要是起搏相关，不是其他疾病诊断

preprocessing.lead_selection: prefer actual MLII, otherwise V5, otherwise first actual channel; 102/104 use V5; never rename physical lead or mix channels silently
preprocessing.window: Actual annotated original sample anchors; full selected channel filtered once with backend.ecg._filter_waveform(raw,360,0); crop 752 points from peak-360-16, then central720 for eval; use float32 BEFORE backend.model_runtime._normalize(...,'zscore') to exactly match production float64 statistics / float32 output. No zero-padding; skip boundaries/nonbeat annotations and record skipped counts. Training jitter +/-12 samples chooses actual shifted720 from stored752, then normalize. No resampling needed360Hz.

split: Group records by actual subject; group201_202 must never overlap partitions. Deterministic label-distribution-aware group search from seed (15000 candidate permutations), 30 training,7 validation,10 test subjects, uses annotation counts ONLY before training. All48 records used, all5 labels present each partition. Prefer train at least one V5 paced group102/104 and at least one MLII paced107/217, remaining paced subjects held out separately. Required counts train N2000,S300,V500,F100,Q2000; val/test N1500,S100,V300,F20,Q1000. Score normalized class-fraction deviations from .65/.15/.20 + modest total-count fraction deviation; no test model outputs ever used to choose split. If constraints impossible, report actual class distribution and fail clearly (do not silently relax). The final split frozen in split.json, report counts and patient IDs and no overlap checks.
cache: Own training/mitbih_cnn_v1/cache. Files windows.npy float32[N,1,752] mmap-able, labels.npy int64[N], record_indices.npy int16[N] indexing metadata.record_ids, peak_indices.npy int64[N], symbols.npy U1[N], train_indices.npy,val_indices.npy,test_indices.npy int64. metadata.json contains actual class counts/skips/records/lead selection/preproc/fingerprint; split.json subject+record lists, class counts, seed/strategy. Fingerprint all source checksums + preprocessing/mapping/split policy; no stale cache reuse if changed. Write outputs atomically where practical. Use original RECORDS only, not x_mitdb copies. Preserve every usable beat, no test oversampling. No data/doc edits outside own cache.

training.model: small residual1D CNN: stem Conv1d1->16 k9 stride2 pad4 BN ReLU (length360); residual block16->32 k7 stride2 + Conv32 k5 stride1 (length180); residual block32->64 k5 stride2 + Conv64 k3 stride1 (length90), each skip Conv1x1 stride2 BN; AvgPool1d6 stride6 ->length15; flatten960; Linear128 ReLU Dropout.25; Linear5 logits. Exportable standard ONNX, no adaptive unsupported pool.
training.device: torch.cuda if actually available else CPU; actual inspectedtorch2.9.1+cpu,no CUDA; set_num_threads8,set_interop_threads2
training.optimizer: AdamW lr0.001 weight_decay0.001; cosine or plateau scheduler based ONLY validation; CrossEntropy label_smoothing0.03
training.sampling: class-balanced WeightedRandomSampler inverse train class frequency;40000 samples/epoch, replacement=True, batch128. Do not use val/test in sampler or optimizer. Train jitter +/-12 samples and small normalized Gaussian noise0.02, no amplitude augmentation cancelled by zscore.
training.selection: max40epochs, early stop8epochs no val macroF1 improvement; checkpoint only best validation macroF1, deterministic seed, real full val everyepoch; never test until selected best checkpoint finalized. Save epoch metrics/loss/confusion actual JSONL with elapsed times and classes support. No fake progress percentages or fabricated benchmarks.
training.outputs: best.pt state_dict plus architecture/config, learning_history.jsonl, training_config.json, evaluation.json with full independent test confusion and per-classprecision/recall/F1/support, macroF1/balancedaccuracy/accuracy (zero-safe), confusion_matrix.csv, learning-curves.png and confusion-matrix.png if matplotlib usable, model.onnx opset17/dynamoFalse dynamicbatch1,NCL, manifest.json exactly production fields, export_parity.json showing real torch vs ORT batches1/8/32 comparison. Export float32 evalmode on CPU; shape[B,1,720]->[B,5]; unsupported package version not silently downgraded. ONNX normalized config lead_names:['selected'],pre360,fs360,input720,bandpass0,zscore,logits, classes exactorder. Name'MIT-BIH 1D-CNN 心搏分类',version'20260930.v1'. Description mention actual prioritizedMLII/2V5 mixed leads, patient-disjoint, Q definition, reference-annotation vs pipeline limitation; no medical validation claim.

ownership.Main: scripts/inspect_training.py, execute preparation/training/evaluation/export checks, pipeline evaluation and platform import/smoke, dependencies, any integration fixes, final deliverables

constraints: Agents must NOT run validation/test/build/lint/format/train/preparation commands; Main runs all. No .md/README docs. Scripts reusable with main guards (Windowsspawn-safe), pathlib pathsunicode. Reuse preprocessing helpers rather than a second normalization/filter definition. Avoid loading duplicate full cache arrays; mmap indices/windows and mini-batches. Metrics numpy count matrix, don't depend global sklearn ABI. Do not alter platform runtime/UI/database/dataset. No synthetic classifier deployed.
environment: .training-venv (system-site-packages reuses user'storch2.9.1+cpu), local numpy1.26.4,wfdb4.3.0,onnx1.23.1,onnxruntime1.23.2, scipy1.15.3; backend/model_runtime.py importable with project root sys.path. Main app .venv unchanged numpy2.2.6.
